scope: Check only the four already-saved R2 STEP artifacts against saved R1 geometry: inventories/topology, unchanged parts and body cavity, ramp pose identities, measured lip drop, preserved stow envelope/flush, explicit mount contacts, deployed mouth void, and 66 sampled clearance pairs. No rebuild, rendering, continuous-sweep, airflow, or visual-approval claim.

thresholds.saved_solid_topology: one valid positive-volume solid per saved leaf

measured_saved_outer_lip_drop_is_half_R1.method: independently pick corresponding lower forward-edge vertices from saved R1/R2 STEP B-reps; compare actual world-Z differences

saved_R1_measurement.description: R1 saved baseline measured from saved edge vertices
saved_R1_measurement.selected_edge: saved floor lower forward outer edge; y=+/-64 mm corners

saved_R2_measurement.description: R2 saved result measured from saved edge vertices
saved_R2_measurement.selected_edge: saved floor lower forward outer edge; y=+/-64 mm corners

deployed_forward_mouth_void_clear.interpretation: Geometric forward mouth clearance only; no airflow-performance claim.

synchronous_66_sample_R2_clearance_and_o.method: 66 saved-input synchronous pose samples: 61 uniform fractions plus five early fractions; inherited R4/A5 reconstruction; R2 ramp rotates saved Stowed ramp by angle*f
